dependency_object.name: FUTURE_COMPLETE_QALL_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH
vertices: one node u for every still-live dynamic vertex u in U
one carrier node [C] for every current residual Y0 component C
edges: u-v for every dynamic adjacency uv in G[U]
u-[C] iff u is complete to C, equivalently u in D_C
dependency_object.identity: This is exactly the already sealed C2 object Q_ALL, now interpreted only as the support/incidence skeleton of the future exact consumer contract.
dependency_object.why_not_current_Hstar: A component with current MIN_BAD(C)=empty has no selector in H*, but a future forced/X0 change can recompile its message into a nontrivial relation on D_C. Therefore future-complete dependency must retain [C]-D_C incidence even when the current selector set is empty.

fixed_seed_X0_effects.support: unary per live vertex through chi_S, chi_X0 and A

B0_provenance.support: unary frozen original provenance plus actual live dynamic relations/component incidence already present in Q_ALL
B0_provenance.note: B0's unbounded hard coordinates are survivor relational structure and Y0-component incidence; these are respectively dynamic edges and u-[C] incidences already represented in Q_ALL.

C0.support: one residual component carrier [C] with boundary scope D_C

C3.support: for every C, selector constraints have neighborhood D_C and therefore refine the same [C]-D_C carrier scope

B2A.support: component C, D_C, A(b), rho/message/delta data for the same Q_ALL block

R1.support_same_block: forcing u=c changes only the Q_ALL block containing u plus unary fixed-color effects within descendants of that block
R1.global_glue: all other blocks contribute only their base-feasibility bits; global truth is target-block forced feasibility AND every untouched block feasible

R2_same_block.support: one Q_ALL block containing u and v
R2_same_block.global_glue: local equal-color forced feasibility AND base-feasibility bits of untouched blocks

R2_cross_block.support: two Q_ALL blocks, one containing u and one containing v
R2_cross_block.factorization: local forced-color feasibility u=c in block i AND local forced-color feasibility v=c in block j AND base-feasibility of all other blocks

B2B1_future_canonicalization.support: block-local under the ancestor Q_ALL decomposition
reason: forcing/fixing deletes dynamic freedom and cannot add dynamic graph edges
retained residual components are whole old components or are deleted

a vertex moved from an old residual component into the dynamic side inherits only graph adjacencies to dynamic vertices already incident to that old component carrier, hence stays inside the ancestor Q_ALL block
D_C only loses dynamic members as vertices are fixed/deleted; it does not acquire vertices from another ancestor block
connectivity-repair components are deleted with independent receipts and never reconnect

reconstruction.support: block-local component receipts attached to [C], plus independent deleted-component receipts
reconstruction.cross_block_glue: concatenate/union block reconstructions and fixed assignment ledger
reconstruction.note: All D_C vertices of a residual component belong to the same Q_ALL block by definition of the carrier node [C].

block_theorem_candidate.name: QALL_FUTURE_DEPENDENCY_BLOCK_COMPLETENESS_V1
block_theorem_candidate.statement: Connected components of current Q_ALL are the maximal connected blocks of the complete declared future dependency hypergraph after B2B2-A/B. No declared future consumer creates a non-factorizable dependency between distinct Q_ALL components.

factorization.cross_block_glue: Boolean AND of local feasibility bits plus concatenation of independent reconstruction receipts
factorization.cost: O(number_of_blocks) glue on top of the sum of local block lifecycle costs
factorization.negative_control: Exponential combinations across disconnected Q_ALL blocks classify as FAIL_EXPLICIT_MEMOIZATION_BUT_FACTORIZED, not a strong B2B2 obstruction.

remaining_connected_object.name: CONNECTED_QALL_DYNAMIC_CORE
content: live dynamic induced graph inside the block
frozen B0 provenance on relevant survivors
residual component carrier nodes with D_C incidence
remaining_connected_object.known_exact_local_carriers: component side is polynomially compiled by C0/C2/C3/B2A
remaining_connected_object.missing_exact_carrier: joint future R1/R2 behavior of the connected dynamic core

scientific_interpretation.positive_global_factorized_representatio: A complete positive theorem still requires a polynomial exact carrier/quotient for each connected Q_ALL dynamic core.
